question: Should runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only with docs/templates updated?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice changes container setup behavior, Podman/Docker parity, and sandbox path semantics across user-facing install surfaces.

options.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

options.title: Document sandbox-only path
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind DooD path decision
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker workspaceAccess path contract first, then align runtime and sandbox path policy together.

recommendation.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent Docker packaging history and already owns the adjacent canonical Docker/DooD workspace contract discussion.
